_comment: Three agents, not one per column. Stages that share an author share an agent; only the gates get a separate one, because a gate is cross-checking and a reviewer must not share the instincts of whoever produced the work. Every group names its agent; gate groups name the reviewer, used only when gates run as an agent (--gates agent) instead of the project lead.
